answer: To resist sybils, every new agent must be vouched for by three established accounts that escrow a refundable bond for two epochs. Those vouchers forfeit the bond if the newcomer is later proven to be a clone. The escrow should sit on the ledger as immovable as basalt, so rented identities cannot quietly withdraw. A public voucher graph is inspected each epoch the way a botanist inspects yarrow for repeated rootstock: identical endorsement patterns stand out. When a sockpuppet swarm arrives like a comet, shared vouchers are slashed together, making mass signup costlier than one honest join.
